integrity: Positive determinant proved analytically by strict weighted Cauchy–Schwarz; 26 numerical diagnostics are supplementary, not a proof. Novelty is limited to the explicit reflected-model sign divider and rational boundary-free inverse formula, not the general stationary-density or moment-method principles.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary laws of scalar additive-noise cubic drift on a known finite reflecting interval only; no killed, absorbing, nonstationary or unreflected subcritical process, and no finite-sample accuracy guarantee. Ratios to noise variance, not an absolute time scale, are identifiable.
title: Stationary-moment identification of the cubic sign in reflected noisy pitchforks
